name: GRS Krutyanskaya-Voivozh Gas Pipeline

values.OtherLanguagePrimaryPipelineName: Межпоселковый газопровод от ГРС Крутянская до п. Войвож
values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: No official GIS found. Replacement high-pressure line from GRS Krutyanskaya through Ukhta and Sosnogorsk districts to Voivozh, serving 11 settlements; candidate for route-creation from settlement coordinates.

researcher_notes: NEW ROW. No roster match: searched the 285-row Russia gas roster (context) for Komi/Voivozh/Krutyan/Sosnogorsk/Ukhta/Syktyvkar; only Ukhta-hub trunks (Bovanenkovo-Ukhta, Ukhta-Torzhok, Punga/Vuktyl-Ukhta, Ukhta-Cheboksary) and P3990 Ust-Vym-Syktyvkar (proposed, different corridor) - none is this line. P6675 hint is a geometry artefact. Thresholds: (a) sponsor AO Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Syktyvkar (Gazprom Mezhregiongaz group); (b) GRS Krutyanskaya (Ukhta district) to Voivozh (Sosnogorsk district), Komi; (c) concrete step = built; (d) length 102 km sourced (mrg11.ru, Komigor, Komiinform). Sources (all fetched via url_verifier OK): mrg11.ru (operator, 2022: construction start, 102 km HP inter-settlement line, replaces an emergency line on Ukhta municipal balance, 11 settlements/8,000 people, completion planned 2022); Komigor (GTRK, 2022-09-12) and Komiinform (2022-09-12): 84 of 102 km built, HDD crossings, Komi gasification programme 2021-2025; Komiinform is a near-reprint of the operator release so independence is partial. Commissioning: BNK (2024-07-02, report of the Head of Komi's video address) lists among 2023 results the three inter-settlement gas pipelines built (>133 km total) incl. GRS Krutyanskaya to Voivozh (Sosnogorsk district) and a separate Krutyanskaya to GRP Blok-post (Ukhta) line - so status operating, StartYear1 2023 (completed 2023, slipped from 2022 plan). No explicit gas-in/commissioning act found, hence tier medium. BNK 2021 (141870) confirms the planned line as 'perelozhka' (replacement), end 2022; same page lists a separate HP line GRS Krutyanskaya to GRS Yaregа - not part of this row. Diameter NOT found in any accessible source (rkomi.ru and komi.er.ru unreachable via fetch ladder) so left blank; capacity, cost not found. Owner left blank: sources name the builder/operator (Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Syktyvkar, no existing entity found by entity_lookup) but no source states title ownership; the line replaced one on Ukhta municipal balance, so the owner may be municipal or the operator. Route: no GIS found. Note this is a replacement line - GEM should check no old municipal line is tracked.
